subject: english
question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

Capable of bending easily without breaking
solution: The correct answer is '**Pliable**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate word for the given group of words is '**Pliable**'. • It means **'easily bent; flexible****'.** (जो आसानी से मुड़ सके या आकृति में ढाला जा सके; लचीला, नम्‍य) • *Example: Some kinds of plastic become **pliable** if they're heated.* **Correct Answer:__** *Pliable.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the **meaning **of other words: • **Rigid**: not able to or not wanting to change or be changed. (किसी को बदलने में असमर्थ या परिवर्तित होने का अनिच्‍छुक) • **Brittle**: hard but easily broken. (कड़ा किंतु सरलता से टूटने वाला; भंगुर) • **Durable**: likely to last for a long time without breaking or getting weaker. (टिकाऊ, स्‍थायी) 3e:T788, The correct answer is '**Resilience**'.
